TOPIC: Перед интервью

TOPIC_DESCRIPTION: Situation: You arrive for a job interview on Friday and first speak to the person at reception before meeting the interviewer. This is a short check-in to announce yourself and get basic instructions so you reach the right room and do not miss the start.
Learner: Job candidate. Partner: Receptionist.
Not in this scene: talking about work experience, answering job questions, discussing salary or schedule.

About the learner, in their own words: Собеседование в пятницу, боюсь вопросов про опыт

must_say:
1. give your name — slot: the name
2. say which position you are applying for — slot: the position
3. answer whether you have been interviewed before — slot: the time or never
4. ask how long the interview will take — slot: none
5. ask whether you should wait here — slot: the place
6. confirm you are ready to begin — slot: none
must_understand:
1. asks for your name and the position
2. asks whether this is your first interview here
3. says the interviewer will be ready soon
4. tells you where to wait or where to go next
